topic: How Tottenham turned around their awful start to the 2008-09 Premier League season after hiring Harry Redknapp.

text_overlays.text: Teams that had AWFUL STARTS TO THE SEASON, but then turned it around
In two thousand eight, Tottenham looked like a club on the rise because they'd just won the League Cup, spent big on players like Luka Modrić, and fans expected a real push up the table.
But eight games later, they'd end up in a spot that no Tottenham team has ever matched, before or since.

Under manager Juande Ramos, Spurs went eight league games without a single win, picking up just two points and sitting dead last, which set the record for the worst start in the club's Premier League history.
Ramos was sacked, and the club paid five million pounds to bring in Harry Redknapp from Portsmouth.
But before Redknapp could even settle in, he was handed the exact fixtures you'd never want when your team is drowning, and if you're enjoying the content please hit the follow button.
His first game, Spurs finally won by beating Bolton two nil to end a twelve game winless run across all competitions.
Three days later they went to Arsenal, took an early lead, then fell behind four two, and scored twice deep into stoppage time to steal a four four draw at their biggest rivals.
Then they beat Liverpool two one with a late winner, giving them seven points in seven days from the team that couldn't win in two months.
And they didn't stop there, because Redknapp dragged them off the bottom and reached a cup final, then finished the season eighth in the league with fifty one points.
